name: Straight Gaff
description: Jab all three tines straight at the opponent's chest while the lead hand slides along the haft.

name: Short Fork
description: Shove the rear hand forward after contact so the outer tines bite deeper into the target.

name: Settled Forktine
description: Raise the haft crosswise to knock a descending blow aside on the wood between hand and tines.

name: Gig Hop
description: Glide the lead foot forward heel first and follow with the rear foot to close distance smoothly.

name: Forward Triplehead
description: Dip the tines and poke the shin of an advancing opponent to check the approach.

name: Stepping Tridentshaft
description: Slide the trident backward through both hands while stepping away so the tines stay aimed at the opponent.

name: Lowered Hookbarb
description: Hold the haft with hands a shoulder width apart and the tines up to screen the chest.

name: Descending Pinch
description: Step into a lunge and drive the center prong at the belly as the rear leg straightens.

name: Triplelid
description: Sweep the outer tine sideways across an incoming weapon to push it off its line.

name: Nimble Sidetine
description: Turn a quarter on the lead foot to face a new direction without crossing the legs.

name: Gigdrop
description: Rap the blunt end of the haft down onto a close opponent's foot to unbalance the stance.

name: Planted Socketbase
description: Plant both feet wide on loose ground and hold the tines forward as a screen while balance settles.

name: Single Prongdrive
description: Dart the trident forward in a short quick stab that snaps back before the target can seize it.

name: Triplehit
description: Flick the tines upward from a low guard into the underside of the opponent's wrist or jaw.

name: Midtine Pause
description: Press the tines down across a fallen opponent's limb and lean on the haft to hold it flat.

name: Nimble Prongroot
description: Shuffle forward with the feet dragging low and flat so the footing holds on slick or uneven ground.

name: Lowered Triprong
description: Swing the haft across the body from low to high to bat a thrust away from the ribs.

name: Descending Barbtine
description: Lift the butt end upward under the guard of a close opponent and drive it into the chin.

name: Gighit
description: Thrust along a straight line from shoulder to target with the elbows tucked and the points level.

name: Tridentstrike
description: Take two quick steps and thrust on the second so the tines arrive just as the foot lands.

name: Triplecowl
description: Catch an incoming blade in the notch between two tines and twist the haft to wrench it off line.

name: Barbtine Hop
description: Step backward with the tines raised and the haft trailing low to cover the retreating foot.

name: Tridenthusk
description: Hold the haft flat over the head with both hands to stop a downward chop from landing.

name: Pinchdrop
description: Slide the lead hand up behind the tines for a short choked jab inside the opponent's reach.

name: Hard Forktine
description: Lean the body's full weight behind a slow heavy shove of the tines to push a lighter opponent back.

name: Tight Sidetine
description: Stand wide and hold the three tines forward at chest height to keep a rushing opponent at reach.

name: Trioblow
description: Roll the shoulder forward through the thrust to add a hand's length of reach to the prongs.

name: Seizedodge
description: Walk forward in short planted steps that keep a heavy frame balanced while the tines lead.

name: Snug Socketbase
description: Wedge the haft against an incoming spear shaft and lean to turn it past the shoulder.

name: Forkstay
description: Press the fork over an opponent's forearm or weapon haft and lean to pin it in place.

name: Level Prongdrive
description: Stamp the lead foot and slam the tines downward onto an opponent's raised guard.

name: Stiff Gaff
description: Swing the haft around with a hip turn so the side tines rake across an opponent's legs.

name: Upward Pinch
description: Breathe out with the thrust so the first flush of qi lengthens the prongs' reach by a hand.

name: Triotrot
description: Circle the lead foot outward while stepping in so the tines come around the opponent's guard.

name: Hooding Prongroot
description: Run a thin film of qi along the haft and angle it to catch a slash on the wood.

name: Sharp Midtine
description: Jab at the face then the chest then the thigh in quick order with qi snapping each point forward.

name: Skipping Fork
description: Hook an outer tine round a post or rail and push off it to leap a pace backward.

name: Leaden Gig
description: Focus qi into the central prong so a straight thrust drives through leather or light mail.

name: Wide Triplehead
description: Rake the outer prongs sideways across an arm or shoulder to tear along the surface.

name: Snug Hookbarb
description: Roll the haft a quarter turn about its axis so a thrust slides off the central prong.

name: Seizehop
description: Step with the knees soft and qi settled in the legs so the tines stay steady while moving.

name: Gaffdash
description: Flick the center prong forward as a feint then pull it back to draw an opponent's guard high.

name: Fouling Triprong
description: Close the outer tines on both sides of a limb and squeeze with the haft to hold it.

name: Prongroot Hit
description: Extend the haft fully at arm's end and shove with qi to keep a charging opponent beyond reach.

name: Tridentshaft Stay
description: Pin an opponent's garment against a post with the tines and hold it there with steady qi pressure.

name: Pinchstrike
description: Slide the fork under a shield rim and heave it up and away with a qi-aided lift.

name: Turning Prongdrive
description: Hook a thrown net on the tines and twist the haft to pull its cords loose from the target.

name: Seize Bump
description: Draw the barbed outer tine back across the target's forearm to open a shallow furrow.

name: Triolid
description: Hold the trident at a slant and slide an incoming blade along the haft away from the hands.

name: Raised Hookbarb
description: Root the rear heel with steady qi so a pinned opponent cannot drag the trident and the wielder off balance.

name: Tight Midtine
description: Meet a downward sword cut in the fork's notch and press it off its line.

name: Forklid
description: Slide a blade into the gap between two tines then twist the haft to lock it there.

name: Tridentpause
description: Hold the tines flat above the head and brace with qi to take a heavy chop on the haft.

name: Easing Seize
description: Step off the line of attack and let the catching fork carry the opponent's blade past the body.

name: Nabbing Triprong
description: Lever the haft sideways after a catch so the trapped weapon is pried from the opponent's grip.

name: Forward Tridentshaft
description: Strike back from the catch with the center prong into the exposed ribs.

name: Raised Forktine
description: Plant the butt on the ground and lean the haft forward at a slant to ward off a rush.

name: Socketbase Dodge
description: Free a caught blade with a backward hop and reset the fork before the opponent recovers.

name: Wide Fork
description: Thrust from a deep crouch with bent legs to reach low targets at the water's edge.

name: Quiet Sidetine
description: Shuffle along a wet bank with the feet flat and qi anchoring each sole against slipping.

name: Triplewedge
description: Brace the haft against a shoving crowd or a surge of water and hold the stance on steadied legs.

name: Fixing Pinch
description: Hook the outer barb behind an opponent's ankle and pull the leg out from under the stance.

name: Folded Triplehead
description: Skim the haft along a falling blade and glance it away over the shoulder.

name: Flat Gig
description: Stab back along the line of the withdrawal with qi sharpening the center prong.
